inspected_anchors.finding: Title, author, venue, dates and gold-label-free judge.
Judge checks schema, internal consistency, trace-output entailment and hint non-dominance; consistent incorrect reasoning can pass.
454 cases; L2 binary VALID/FLAWED versus three-label L3; historical calls through January2026. L1 N50 per-class/N100 overall conflicts with Table7.
Table4 is binary L2; switching an incorrect label equals correction in that two-label setting. Source-reported rounded initial/final accuracies and bad/good flips.
Subjectivity, protocol dependence, black-box attribution, absent component ablation and non-certification limitations.
Table7 totals L1=50,L2=304,L3=100. Confounding vignette labels causal claim NO and describes association as spurious.

supported_claims: RCA checks consistency without a gold scientific oracle; this does not certify a true causal model.
Binary Table4 transitions are distinct from a generalized three-label correction metric.
The L1 denominator inconsistency prevents defensible pooled reconstruction without further evidence.
limitations: Bounded original-text review; no model calls, upstream runtime, bank experiment or measured ROI.
The inherited113-candidate corpus remains incomplete; complementary searches and additional citation leads remain open.
No complete dependency, code, data or model reuse permission review is supplied.
Rendered visual acceptance remains false under the inherited exhausted image allowance.
The recovery summary suggested a three-label flaw in Table4; reinspection resolves Table4 as binary L2. Do not attribute the authored multiclass failure to that table.
Do not infer zero treatment effect merely from the vignette identifying confounding; label NO can instead mean an unsupported causal assertion.
Historical model findings are protocol-specific reported results, not current model rankings.

Primary reference list identifies Le2024 and Causal-Copilot2025; citation identity does not substitute for original inspection.

supported_claims: Reported orchestration spans discovery, structural models, root-cause attribution and effect estimation.
Sachs SHD21→23 worsens under HPO alone although F1 .323→.343 improves; later knowledge-assisted settings have lower SHD.
The demonstrations use ALARM and Sachs, with domain knowledge taken from their original papers; temporal and high-dimensional robustness are future work.
limitations: Bounded original-text review; no model calls, upstream runtime, bank experiment or measured ROI.
The inherited113-candidate corpus remains incomplete; complementary searches and additional citation leads remain open.
No complete dependency, code, data or model reuse permission review is supplied.
Rendered visual acceptance remains false under the inherited exhausted image allowance.
No independent execution, statistical uncertainty, held-out bank comparison or complete code/license audit.
BIC is an observed-fit criterion; a favorable score does not by itself resolve intervention direction.
Exact publication day is metadata-derived; the inspected PDF confirms proceedings year rather than an independently verified day.

inspected_anchors.finding: Title, authors, preprint status, date and rights notice.
Regex association/causal extraction, heuristic directions, Hill criteria and topology-based exposure/outcome labels; acyclicity check.
Functional demonstrations and described testing; no calibrated causal-effect coverage study established by this passage.
Usability12 participants in two groups of6; average task initiation within2 rounds, not identification validation.
Illustrative literature-to-causal conclusion workflow; observational evidence needs explicit assumptions rather than automatic causal promotion.
Systematic expert review, real-world functional validation, larger user tests and comparisons with manual analysis listed as future work.
Future open-source release after initial validation; current runtime and software reuse permission not established.

supported_claims: EpiCausalX describes retrieval, heuristic relationship extraction and interactive diagrams.
Graph-root/sink typing is a source heuristic and not a general definition of exposure and outcome.
Usability evidence and future validation plans must be separated from causal identification or confidence-interval performance.
limitations: Bounded original-text review; no model calls, upstream runtime, bank experiment or measured ROI.
The inherited113-candidate corpus remains incomplete; complementary searches and additional citation leads remain open.
No complete dependency, code, data or model reuse permission review is supplied.
Rendered visual acceptance remains false under the inherited exhausted image allowance.
Original is a non-peer-reviewed preprint; no present open-source release established by its future-tense statement.
PDF states all rights reserved/no reuse without permission; a local research copy is not evidence of software/data integration permission.
No health-effect assertion is adopted from the demonstration.

source_correction: Table4 is binary L2; the multiclass concern is a prospective extension, not a demonstrated source defect.
unresolved_source_issue: Chang L1 N100 in narrative versus50 in Table7; no fabricated denominator reconciliation.

evidence.anchor: Three primary and one authored record
